fixture.loading_method: Direct SQL in a disposable local test database, permitted only for accumulated-query performance. Not evidence that receiving/inspection business workflows passed.
fixture.application_grants: Normal db-bootstrap --grant permissions, applied only to this owned fixture; role and table ownership unchanged.

method.client_location: same local container over loopback HTTP/TCP
method.statistic: nearest-rank p95 over successful samples; any unexpected error makes the metric fail
method.read_write_ratio: 100% business/API GET reads; ordinary request telemetry and auth session maintenance can write their own rows. Physical inventory and business documents are unchanged.
method.server_timing_diagnostics: Explicitly disabled during acceptance measurements; opt-in diagnostics require a separate diagnostic runtime.

inventory_display.first_page_timing: Navigation through first100rows plus two animation frames; total1600/page0/page-size100 are checked in every sample.
inventory_display.independent_preservation: After timed samples: both companies traverse16pages and compare all1600keys,7bucket values,global totals,full CSV,full-scope search and last-page traces with the independent manifest.
inventory_display.comparison: Display condition changed from the preserved1600-simultaneous-DOM profile. Earlier pass/failure is retained separately;2s/company/sample counts/1Mledger/API scope are unchanged.

method.concurrent_other_workloads: No other test/build/diagnostic workload; local PostgreSQL services only

database_role.name: wms_app
database_role.rls: FORCE RLS with tenant, authenticated user and explicit warehouse grant context
